status: Prepared for Founder review; not approved for manufacture

products.name: The Utkal T-shirt
products.proposal: Relaxed crew neck; 100% combed cotton; 220 GSM; sizes S-XXL. These are quote targets, not selected stock.
products.placement: Centre front, top of print 80 mm below the front neck seam on the proposed M sample. Confirm size grading and print clearance. Back blank.
products.process: Ask for a soft-hand screen-print sample and a short-run transfer alternative. Vendor to specify ivory underbase, registration and care.
products.confirm: Blank SKU, composition/GSM evidence, size chart, shrinkage, wash/rub result, actual print box and unit costs.
products.sample: One M sample proposed, plus fabric and colour swatches. Founder to confirm size and spend.

products.name: The Tasar Jhula
products.base: Natural golden Tasar silk outer - Founder-selected material; shade/sample pending
products.proposal: Tasar silk outer shell; proposed cotton lining and reinforced handles. Body 380 x 420 mm, 80 mm gusset, 650 mm handles remain quote targets. Supplier to propose suitable fabric weight.
products.placement: Centre front on the body. Top of print 60 mm below top hem; 50 mm side margins at the proposed body width. Reverse blank.
products.process: Sample a sea-blue and laterite print compatible with the actual silk. Confirm ink, curing and care; no generic canvas transfer process assumed.
products.confirm: Tasar fibre composition, fabric provenance, separate lining/handle materials, fabric weight, seams, handle-load test, colourfastness, print rub/cleaning results and costs.
products.sample: One lined, decorated sample plus unprinted silk swatch. Approve hand-feel, drape, print, reinforced stitching and load/care results before a batch.

products.name: The Story Cup
products.proposal: 330 ml ceramic mug; straight-sided blank preferred for the story wrap. Supplier confirms actual capacity and dimensions.
products.placement: 200 x 85 mm preliminary continuous illustrated wrap. Riverbank launch, sea voyage and welcoming shore flow around the cup. Prominent 72 mm wide outlined UTKAL above the central sailing scene; no narrative text. Vendor to confirm handle gap and bleed.
products.process: Ask for full-colour ceramic transfer/decal sampling compatible with the chosen blank. This detailed illustration is raster artwork, not a three-spot-colour design.
products.confirm: Capacity, diameter/height, full printable template, handle clearance, glaze/decoration process, colour swatches and supported care/contact-use documentation.
products.sample: One decorated sample proposed. Inspect scene continuity around the handle, fine detail, colours and prominent UTKAL wordmark and its clear space.

products.name: The Utkal Water Bottle
products.base: Matte black and Nila Sagara blue - both retained by Founder
products.proposal: Premium 750 ml target: double-wall vacuum-insulated stainless steel, SS 304 inner wall, wide-mouth screw cap, integrated carry loop and replaceable seal. Supplier blank and performance remain unverified.
products.placement: 70 x 150 mm proposed front panel on both colours; ivory sails and Odia wordmark, laterite hull/rule, two straw waves. Refit to the selected premium blank; not a wrap.
products.process: Ask for a multi-colour screen/transfer method compatible with the coating. Confirm smallest gaps, colour registration and abrasion durability.
products.confirm: Actual capacity/weight, steel grade evidence, insulation test conditions/results, leak/loop-load tests, coating abrasion, printable template, replacement seals/lids and warranty.
products.sample: One decorated sample in each colour proposed. Compare cap/loop, cleaning access, seal, insulation, finish and print; Founder approves costs before ordering.

cup_story.title: A story in pictures
scenes: Small boats launched from an Odisha riverbank
A maritime journey across the sea
cup_story.interpretation: An imaginative visual sequence connecting ritual remembrance, voyages and exchange; not a literal reconstruction of a particular voyage, community or historical ship.
cup_story.inspection: Full primary source read; supports maritime commemoration and floating boats, not every depicted scene or vessel.
cup_story.artwork_format: 1923 x 818 pixel raster illustration embedded unchanged; approximately 244 ppi at 200 x 85 mm; supplier to assess process and actual-size proof.
